case_name: Formation of new States and alteration of areas, boundaries or names of existing States
issues: alteration of areas, boundaries or names of existing States
court_reasoning: The power conferred on Parliament by clause (a) includes the power to form a new State or Union territory...
holding: Parliament may form a new State by separation of territory from any State or by uniting two or more States or parts of States or by uniting any territory to a part of any State; Parliament may increase the area of any State; Parliament may diminish the area of any State; Parliament may alter the boundaries of any State; Parliament may alter the name of any State.
